title: Trace a next-token decision
description: Change the retained context, temperature, and decoding rule. Watch probability move independently from source verification.
prompt: Complete the answer: The capital of France is

contexts.label: Verified source retained
contexts.detail: A current, authoritative source in the context explicitly supports Paris.

contexts.label: No source retained
contexts.detail: The model relies on patterns in its weights; no request-time evidence supports the answer.

contexts.label: Unverified conflict retained
contexts.detail: An untrusted passage claims Lyon. Repetition in context can overpower a correct learned prior.

candidates.continuation: Paris. The answer matches the known fact, but the system should call it verified only when current authoritative evidence supports it.
Lyon. This can become the most likely continuation when unverified text dominates the context, even though the claim is wrong.
I cannot verify this from the retained evidence. Ask for a current authoritative source before treating the claim as verified.
Rome. Sampling can choose a low-probability candidate; decoding diversity is not a factuality control.
